components.name: Play / Stop
components.description: The one solid primary; inverts while playing.
components.css: .ds-play { width: 100%; min-height: 84px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); background: var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--paper, #f2f2ee); font: 800 1.75rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-play[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--paper, #f2f2ee); color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nudge Button
components.description: Outlined tempo nudge; inverts on press.
components.css: .ds-nudges { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-nudge { min-height: 64px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); background: var(--paper, #f2f2ee); color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 800 1.5rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-tap { font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nudge:active { background: var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--paper, #f2f2ee); } .ds-nudge:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Button

components.css: .ds-text-btn { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); background: none; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 800 1rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-btn:disabled { border-color: var(--rule-soft, #b9b9b2); color: var(--rule-soft, #b9b9b2); cursor: default; } .ds-text-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Radio choices as square outlined Caslon chips; selected gains teal border, inset underline and bold.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-seg label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-seg span { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 48px; min-width: 56px; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 500 1.125rem/1 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; } .ds-seg input:checked + span { border-color: var(--select, #008fa6); box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 var(--select, #008fa6); font-weight: 700; } .ds-seg input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Labelled square number input in Caslon figures.
components.css: .ds-num { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #55554f); max-width: 220px; } .ds-num input { min-height: 52px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #f2f2ee); color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 700 1.5rem/1 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-num input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Square outlined check with an inset paper square when checked.
components.css: .ds-check { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-check span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 700 1.375rem/1.2 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; } .ds-check span::before { content: ''; flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-check input:checked + span::before { background: linear-gradient(var(--paper, #f2f2ee), var(--paper, #f2f2ee)) center / 10px 10px no-repeat, var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-check input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Row List
components.description: Saved items in a sheet: Caslon title over uppercase Franklin meta, text-button actions right, 1px Pencil Rule separators.
components.html:
• Slow 8/4 grid30 BPM · 8/4
  • Paradiddle warm-up96 BPM · 4/4
components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-rows li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; grid-template-areas: 'title load delete' 'meta load delete'; column-gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #b9b9b2); } .ds-rows li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row-title { grid-area: title; font: 700 1.25rem/1.2 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; } .ds-row-meta { grid-area: meta; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.4 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #55554f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row-btn { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); background: none; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 800 1rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-empty { margin: 0; font: 400 1.125rem/1.4 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #55554f); }

components.name: Running Head
components.description: The page's head line: title left, underlined text link right, 1px ink rule under.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 14px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #141414); color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-head-link { padding: 10px 8px; margin: -10px -8px -10px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; text-transform: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-soft, #b9b9b2); text-underline-offset: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-head-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sticking Line
components.description: Signature: engraved notes on one staff line between heavy rules, with the orange pencil ring on the live note.
components.html:
1. 1
  2. 2
  3. 3
  4. 4
components.css: .ds-line { --note-h: 110px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 10px 0 4px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-line li { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; } .ds-line li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--note-h) * 0.79 - 1px); height: 2px; background: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-note { position: relative; width: 100%; height: var(--note-h); color: var(--ink, #141414); cursor: pointer; } .ds-note svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; fill: currentColor; } .ds-ghost { color: var(--ink-ghost, #74746d); } .ds-ghost svg { transform: scale(0.82); transform-origin: 50% 80%; } .ds-note svg.ds-ring { left: 50%; top: 78%; width: calc(var(--note-h) * 0.46); height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-9deg); } .ds-ring path { fill: none; stroke: var(--pencil, #ff4f00); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-note:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--select, #008fa6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-count { font: 400 1.375rem/1 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #55554f); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a page of an engraved drum method book, set to be read from the drum throne 1.5 to 2 metres away. The tempo is the page heading, set as a huge Caslon numeral; the bar is a line of real engraved notation between two heavy rules; the controls are square, outlined, and set in a heavy grotesque at the foot of the page. Everything is ink on paper. There is no chassis, no glow, no LED, no gradient: the category default of glowing dots around a thin numeral on black is the thing this system refuses.

Density is low and the type is very large, because the reader is far away and holding sticks. The page has one solid black primary (Play/Stop), one orange pencil mark that circles the live note on every beat, and one teal for selection and focus. A night page prints the same book in reverse for dim practice rooms: the tokens swap, the rules do not.
keyCharacteristics: Cool off-white paper and engraving black; colour is reserved for two jobs only.
Libre Caslon Text for everything read (numerals, headings, notation counts, choice text); Libre Franklin for labels and control verbs.
Notation drawn as filled engraved shapes, not icons: wedge accent, tapered stem, rotated notehead, crescent ghost parentheses, quarter rest.
Square corners everywhere, 2px ink outlines, 2px heavy rules around the notation, 1px rules under heads.
State never carried by colour alone: accents differ in shape, ghosts in size and parentheses, play state in inversion and label.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only as the ring on the note being played. If orange is on screen while the metronome is stopped, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Teal Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: Teal marks selection and keyboard focus, and nothing else. A checked choice also gains a bold weight and an inset underline, so it never relies on hue.

rules.name: The Read-In-Caslon Rule
rules.body: Any number or word the drummer reads for meaning (tempo, bar, time, counts, option names, sheet titles) is Caslon. Franklin is for labels and verbs on controls.

rules.name: The Running Head Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Franklin belongs to the page's running head and to form-field labels, as a printed book uses it. It does not appear as a decorative line above headings.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: No shadows on page elements. Separation comes from 2px ink rules and outlines; only an overlay sheet casts a shadow.

dos: Do set tempo, bar, time and counts in Libre Caslon Text with lining tabular figures, large enough to read from 2 m.
Do keep orange (`pencil`) for the live-note ring alone, and teal (`select`) for selection and focus alone.
Do draw controls as square, 2px ink outlines on paper, with one solid ink primary per screen; press and active states invert.
Do draw notation as filled engraved shapes in the same hand as the existing glyphs.
Do give every state a non-colour signal: shape, weight, size, inversion, or label.
Do keep transport targets at 64px minimum (84px for Play/Stop) in the bottom thumb zone.
Do ship every new surface on both pages by using the tokens; never hard-code a light-page hex.
donts: Don't use glowing dots, LED readouts, dark chassis styling, or a thin numeral on black; that is the category default this world replaces.
Don't round corners on controls, fields, or sheets.
Don't cast shadows on page elements; only an overlay sheet lifts.
Don't use orange for buttons, accents, links, or text.
Don't put uppercase tracked lines above headings as decoration; uppercase Franklin is for the running head and field labels.
Don't substitute icon-font or emoji glyphs for notation or controls.
